Chapter 7139: Kun Peng

Chapter 7139: Kun Peng

Their saviors never viewed them as people, only slaves and food. Now, it was time for them to prove their worth to the saviors.

“This action is against the noble pursuit of cultivation.” Worldbearer said.

“You’re behind the times, Elder.” QIlin said: “What pursuit matters compared to our survival? The dead have none.”

“You have fallen, losing your noble heart, Qilin. What a shame.” Worldbearer lamented.

“Elder, that does not help with our survival. Come, be one of us again.” Qilin’s expression changed.

“Elder, I have paid back my debt, now it’s an internal matter.” Ninth Lady didn’t like this development and escaped with haste.

Apex and the others became alarmed. Worldbearer knew he would lose without these primordial immortals’ help.

“Bam!” A piercing strike aimed for her chest. She reacted swiftly with her red strings, releasing all of their defensive potential.

“Bam!” It still broke through, making her fall.

“Rat, show yourself!” She shouted once stabilized.

A primordial light erupted, terrorizing Divine Firmament. Within was a divine beast with two interchanging forms - a kun and a peng. The world twisted with its transformation, returning to the chaos each time.

“Kun Peng!” The monarch knew this would happen but was still shocked.

“Kun Peng.” The primordial immortals on the opposite side wore ugly expressions.

Kun Peng was from the same generation as Skykiller and Phoenix, believed to be only second to them.

Although Gluttonous and Qilin competed against him, he was still considered the strongest by the divine beasts and the dragon servants.

However, Kun Peng lived reclusively and didn’t bother to compete for authority. If he had stuck around in Skykiller Palace, he would still be in charge.

“Finally became impatient.” Chongming Immortal Monarch murmured.

Since he was in a position of authority once, he knew that Kun Peng was secretly in charge. The other great divine beasts, such as Lunar Wolf and Death Serpent, obeyed his command.

“Elder, this is needless struggling. Prioritize the divine beasts or be punished.” Kun Peng spoke.

For the other ones, they viewed Worldbearer Tortoise as an actual senior. After all, he watched them grow up. Kun Peng, on the other hand, gave a command.

“You do not command me, Kun Peng.” Worldbearer said: “Just because I didn’t compete doesn’t mean you are above me. Let the mastermind behind you speak.”

The mentioning of a “mastermind” surprised and piqued everyone’s interest.
